verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic access to call data: post-call webhooks are sent to your server after every call completes (bland-docs-5), and the MCP server can inspect calls (bland-docs-20). Evals and testbed read historical call conversations from call logs, which implies transcripts exist (bland-docs-28, bland-docs-43). None of the evidence explicitly says transcripts or audio recordings can be retrieved through an API or webhook payload. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of transcript retrieval via API or webhook, any evidence of recording/audio download, confirmation of coverage for every call, and independent corroboration.
